Coded Renewable Portfolio Standard rules

Source: R/rps_rules.R
rps_rules.Rd

Reads the RPS rule coding that feeds rps_stringency(). By default this is the coding bundled with the package in inst/extdata/; you can point to your own files with the same layout to correct or extend it.

Usage

rps_rules(states = NULL, rules_path = NULL, targets_path = NULL)

Arguments

states

Optional states to keep.

rules_path, targets_path

Paths to CSV files with your own coding. Default: the files bundled with the package.

Value

An object of class rps_rules: a list with data frames rules and targets.

Details

The coding has two tables:

rules (one row per state): has_rps (1 = mandatory RPS, 0 = none), enacted_year, first_compliance_year, repeal_year, target_type ("share" of retail sales, or "capacity_mw"), final_target, final_target_year, coverage_share (share of retail sales covered), out_of_state_rec, carveout, acp (0/1 design indicators), carveout_types, acp_usd_mwh, baseline_re_share (optional existing renewable share at enactment; filled from data by build_panel()), source, verified and notes. Optional: baseline_includes_hydro (1 if the targets count existing hydro, so the incremental baseline should too; default 0).

targets (one row per legal target): state, year, target (share of sales between 0 and 1, or MW for capacity targets).

States that do not appear in the rules table are treated as not yet coded, and their stringency measures are NA rather than zero.

Status of the bundled coding

The bundled coding covers all 50 states and DC. Rows with verified = TRUE have been hand-checked against the statute, the DSIRE program page and the LBNL RPS & CES data, as set out in the package's validation plan; source and notes give the citations and coding choices. Please report corrections on the issue tracker.

r <- rps_rules()
